note: Operator-authored truth for the three dimensions no measurement in this repository provides. Tempo comes from measured.json, lyric positions from lyrics.aligned.json plus ground_truth_adjudication.json, and section boundaries from measured.json summary.sections — none of those belong here. Every entry below starts as `unadjudicated`, and the scorers ABSTAIN rather than guess while it says so. `tools/mimo_bench/run.py plan` prints how many dimensions are still abstaining.

how_to_fill.key: Set tonic to a pitch name (C, C#, Db, ... using either spelling; the scorer normalizes enharmonics) and mode to `major`, `minor`, `dorian`, `mixolydian`, `phrygian`, `lydian`, `locrian` or `modal`. Set status to `adjudicated`. If the excerpt has no stable tonal centre, set status to `none` and leave tonic null; a model claiming a key is then scored as a false claim rather than abstaining.
how_to_fill.meter: Set value to a time signature string such as `4/4`, `3/4`, `6/8`, `7/8`, or `free` when there is no metre. Set status to `adjudicated`.
how_to_fill.instruments: `present` is the list a careful listener would name for THIS 100 s excerpt, in canonical lexicon terms (see INSTRUMENT_LEXICON in scorers.py; unknown names are reported by the plan command so the lexicon can grow). `allowed_extra` are plausible names that neither count for recall nor against precision — a synth pad you are unsure about. `absent` are hallucination canaries: instruments definitely NOT present, each of which costs precision hard when claimed.

constellation-whale.notes: The adjudicated line 24 text is "Neither major, neither minor", which is a lyric about tonality and not evidence of one. Do not let it stand in for the key entry.
